thread:
Marta Lopez: Dropping the latest RFI packet for Pegasus into the drive. Files: /drive/pegasus/rfi/pegasus_rfi_packet_2026-03-21.zip and /drive/pegasus/rfi/capability_matrix_v3.xlsx. Two open items flagged by procurement: exact HSM support statement and a sample POC SOW line item for reserved capacity. Need signoff from SE + Security before we mark answered. @Jamie @Priya @Devin

Jamie Chen: I skimmed the matrix. We should show both a hosted baseline and a dedicated-reserved line in the capability CSV. I'll add a small note column explaining when to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted. Also pushing a lightweight k6 loadfile for their infra to /drive/pegasus/poc/k6_scripts/k6_embed_test.js

Devin Park: From pricing ops: propose two reserved SKUs for the POC (monthly commit): "dedicated-small" (4 GPUs) and "dedicated-medium" (8 GPUs). I'll draft the SOW snippet with monthly commit, burst credits for the first 30 days, and a 30-day rollback window. Ballpark hosted estimate for 50k vectors/day is $600/mo (depends on batching).

Priya Shah: Security: procurement specifically asked "Are FIPS 140-2 HSMs supported and how are keys wrapped?" My suggested canonical answer below — please review: 

```
Security & Key Management: Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) via cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) for hosted deployments and integrates with PKCS#11 compatible HSMs for on-prem or Private deployments. For customers requiring FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs, we recommend Redwood Private with validated HSM appliances; keywrap and management can be implemented via KMIP or PKCS#11 depending on the customer's HSM. We can include a compliance addendum specifying FIPS-validated hardware on the contract schedule.
```

Priya Shah: Also note: logging/audit export for key usage can be enabled to a customer-owned SIEM in Private and Dedicated flows; hosted CMEK exposes key access logs in the cloud provider console.

Samir Kapoor: Minor ask from procurement: can we include an explicit PII/data residency acceptance criteria? Suggest: "All EU customer data processed in EU regions for the duration of the POC, with logs and backups stored in-region."

Marta Lopez: Good — I'll include that. POC acceptance criteria (draft): 1) 99th percentile single-vector embedding latency < 250ms for hosted POC baseline, 2) sustained batch embedding throughput >= 4k vectors/min, 3) EU-only processing and storage, 4) end-to-end request traceability and audit logs enabled. Anyone object?

Jamie Chen: Sounds reasonable. Small tweak: if they run the hosted loadtest across many short-lived connections latencies could spike; recommend we document the recommended client-side batching (6-8 items per request) to hit the throughput targets. I'll add that guidance to the CSV and the RFI doc.

Devin Park: SOW snippet (draft) — paste for legal/finance review:

```
SOW (POC Reserved Capacity): Redwood will provision a dedicated GPU pool for the Pegasus POC under SKU dedicated-small (4x A100 equiv). Monthly commitment: $XX,XXX. POC term: 30 days. Included 30k free embedding credits and one-time setup support. Optional burst credits up to 50% capacity for first 14 days. Rollback: customer may terminate the dedicated pool within 30 days and will be billed pro-rata for the commit term.
```

Jamie Chen: Quick test curl for embeddings (for their infra team):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-pro","input":["example sentence"],"batch_hint":4}'
```

Priya Shah: Legal may ask for a line about key escrow 1: we do not escrow customer KMS keys by default; for Private deployments customer controls the appliance and keys. I'll add that sentence to the security answer.

Marta Lopez: Owners & deadlines: Jamie 1 update CSV with guidance + recommended batching by Tue 11:00. Priya 1 finalize HSM/KMS language and key escrow sentence by Tue EOD. Devin 1 pricing + SOW options by Wed morning. I'll assemble and send to procurement Thurs AM if all green.

Samir Kapoor: FYI procurement asked for a short comparison row on the matrix: "embed cost per 1k vectors (hosted vs dedicated)" 1 Jamie/Devin can you add an estimate column?

Devin Park: Adding that. I'll include a formula note explaining assumptions: avg tokens per vector, batching factor, and typical caching hit-rate.
